title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of particle 1's velocity before the first collision as qBa/m.

title: Mass of particle 2
description: Essential: Correctly states the mass of particle 2 as m/2.

title: Post-collision velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of particle 2's velocity after the first collision as 3qBa/m.

title: Final position coordinates
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the coordinates of particle 1 as (-6a, 0) and particle 2 as (0, 0) at the specified time.

title: Total path length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total path length traversed by particle 2 as 67πa.

title: Period-mass relationship
description: Important: Applies the relationship between cyclotron period and mass (T ∝ m) to deduce the mass of particle 2 from the given frequency ratio.

title: Collision analysis
description: Important: Applies conservation of momentum and kinetic energy correctly to the first elastic collision to find unknown velocities.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: Correctly determines trajectory radii from Lorentz force and uses geometry to find collision times and positions.

title: Path length summation
description: Optional: Demonstrates correct summation of partial arc lengths over multiple collision intervals to find the total path.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to velocities in momentum conservation or misinterprets post-collision direction reversal.

title: Radius or period formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Misapplies the formulas r = mv/(qB) or T = 2πm/(qB), leading to incorrect radii, times, or masses.
